verdict.rationale: Automated follow-up on overdue invoices is a fair question for a finance and payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers AP-side automation: invoice entry, approval, and payments, plus bill tracking. Nothing documents automatic reminders or dunning for overdue invoices, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have overdue invoices automatically followed up on without manual chasing
